about: Fee components researched by the owner's research recovery package of November 19, 2026 (docs/recovery/package/data/scoped-immigration-fees.json), each as it applies in the game: `applies` names the application (visa or work permit), the component (paid on applying, or on issue only) and whose application it is (where they live, their passport, the date); `held` says why a record isn't charged. A record never replaces a country's terms for everyone: it applies only where its conditions hold (src/engine/papers-scoped.ts). Imported November 20, 2026.

conventions.placeOfApplication: Where you live is where you apply: the game has no consulates, so a consulate's price list (Washington's) applies to those who live in the United States, and Colombia's euro schedule to those who live in a euro country (the rest pay its dollar schedule). A game convention, not a rule read anywhere.

records.route: Tourist visa from a Nepalese mission
records.scope: Nationalities with no visa on arrival
records.note: No visa on arrival for these passports (and refugees with travel documents): they apply at a Nepalese mission first. The fee is the Department of Immigration's schedule; each mission's own price wasn't checked. No mission's decision time was found, so it is the game's estimate.

source.note: Nepal Tourism Board, Tourist visa: nationalities that must get a visa before arriving, and those given a free visa.

records.scope: Chinese nationals
